import random, json, sys, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
from language import load, InvalidProgram, StaticError
from checker import check
import fuzz

rng=random.Random(7)
tags=collections.Counter(); acc=0
for it in range(20000):
    p=fuzz.gen_program(rng)
    text=json.dumps(p)
    try:
        q=load(text)
    except Exception: continue
    cov=set()
    try:
        check(q,cov)
    except StaticError: continue
    except Exception: continue
    acc+=1
    tags.update(cov)
print("accepted:",acc)
for k,v in sorted(tags.items()): print(f"  {k:18s} {v}")
EOF
